detail: Stubs were set on the OscRuntime SingletonDecorator, not the class, so they never applied; the journey harness guard read the old Configuration key. Now stubs patch OscRuntime.klass and journeys listen on 127.0.0.1 at an OS-picked port (new j12).
title: OSC tests and journeys bound the real port 0.0.0.0:8001
